issues.problem: Google Fonts is blocked in mainland China and jsDelivr/cdnjs are unreliable there. The font stylesheet is render-blocking, so first paint can stall; all 8 3D displays fall back to GIFs. Tested here with both hosts unreachable: fonts fell back, every 3D display showed '此处无法显示 3D（库加载失败）'.
issues.fix: Self-host the fonts (or subset Noto Sans SC) and three.js r128 + the 5 example scripts under assets/; or load fonts with media=print onload swap so they never block.

issues.quote: 此处无法显示 3D（库加载失败），改为显示录制的动画。 / GIF labels 'rays entering the upper layer', 'N 16 · crossed both 0'
issues.problem: On a phone the 16:9 fallback GIF sits in a 4:5 stage (.evd-stage aspect-ratio 4/5 at ≤600px) with large black bands; its labels are English-only and ~5 px tall. For a low-vision Chinese reader the fallback is unreadable.
issues.fix: Size the fallback stage to the GIF's aspect ratio; record zh versions of the GIFs (or no burned-in text) and repeat the key numbers in the caption.

issues.section: figures (.fig-svg), e.g. week10 · 10.1 加上磁场
issues.problem: On a 390 px phone the right ~40% of each SVG figure is off-screen with no scroll hint (week10: 'f = (γμ/2π) B', 'B 沿 +x，垂直纸面向里' and 'U (+y)' cut). At 1280×800 with 200% zoom (640 px viewport) the 620 px figure is clipped by 12 px in a 608 px column.
issues.fix: Provide a stacked portrait variant or let the svg scale (min-width ≤ container) and raise SVG font-size so text stays ≥12 px; at minimum add a visible '← 左右滑动 →' hint and set the breakpoint so 640 px does not clip.
